historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Foxtrot navigation correction: separate the drawer toggle from the header menu and contain row endpoint submenus.
historical_adaptations.rationale: The complete default source stylesheet still requires the drawer separation and third-menu endpoint correction at mobile widths. The fourth parent wraps at 390px, so right-anchoring it creates a new left escape and is removed. Trusted native A/B exercises all eight parent actions with the retained correction. W13 re-certification note: on the current reference snapshot all four parents stay on one row in Chromium as well, so the row endpoint is the last parent; the block now right-anchors the last parent submenu too (the same remedy as the WebKit endpoint block), verified by the W13 re-certification A/B.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Foxtrot WebKit row endpoint: contain the fourth submenu where the engine keeps all parents on one row.
historical_adaptations.rationale: Freeze-3 restore (OD-T3-b branch (a)): W13 (1ec1cba28e) removed this WebKit-only block and extended the navigation correction block with the same pin for all engines at 360-767px; on the current contract that all-engines pin makes the fourth (li:last-child) submenu escape LEFT by 45.8px at 390px in Chromium (TL-02 full check, 13 surface_navigation_viewport_escape errors). The Freeze-3 E-fx2 toggle probe returns the pin to its Freeze-1 WebKit-only @supports scope: in Chromium the escape clears to 0 fails, and in WebKit the toggled candidate is row-identical to the pre-fix candidate in all 92 navigation bounds with the fourth submenu contained and the pin active. The block text is verbatim the pre-W13 text (sha256 identical to the pre-removal ledger entry). Freeze-3 delta evidence on the built candidate extends the toggle to Firefox.
